objectTypes.doc: A region's ambience: the region, the bank clip it loops, its volume and the crossfade on entering the region.

fields.name: clipId

objectTypes.doc: A music state: its id, the bank clip it loops, the crossfade into it and an optional stinger played on entry.

objectTypes.doc: The audio content of a game: bank, music states (with the start state), region ambiences and the mixer.

fields.name: ambiences

objectTypes.doc: A conversation: line, choice, branch, action and end nodes joined by edges; conditions read facts and state.

objectTypes.doc: An inventory: slots, weight limit, starting currency and items.

fields.name: entries

objectTypes.doc: A vendor: stock, prices, and payment in currency or in an item (old coins).

fields.doc: Filter of dialogueEnded / choiceMade: the dialogue graph.

tools.doc: Add a component to a scene object. An [Authorable] component gets a fresh authoring id and optional initial field values.

args.doc: [Authorable] type id or component type full name.

args.name: authoringId
args.doc: Restore a specific authoring id (journal undo/redo).

tools.doc: Generate an asset (image, texture, voice line, mesh) through an etos task. Returns the task; the artifact arrives later in a candidate change set.

args.name: kind
args.doc: What to generate: image, texture, portrait, voice, mesh, ...

tools.doc: Verified import: write a retained media artifact to 'path' under Assets/, import it with importer settings and re-check its sha256 on disk. The bytes are retained in Studio/Artifacts.

args.name: importer
args.doc: Importer settings (public importer properties by name).

tools.doc: Assign a reference ([AuthorRef] field) to another authored thing or an asset; null clears. For list fields, 'append' adds and 'index' replaces one element.

args.name: value
args.doc: The referenced thing: an AuthoringRef, an authoring id, name@revision or an asset path; null clears.

args.name: index
args.doc: List fields: the element to replace.

args.name: append
args.doc: List fields: append instead of replacing the list.

tools.doc: Puts an imported AudioClip into an audio bank under a stable id, with its mixer group, volume, loop and 3D settings.
Requests a sound effect through the registered optional sound-effect capability; otherwise answers NotConfigured (GP-AUD-020).
Requests a spoken line through the media gateway (etos op tts); the clip arrives later as a candidate for audio.assignClip. NotConfigured (GP-AUD-020) until a gateway exists.

args.name: clipId
args.doc: Bank clip id the line is meant for (e.g. voice.warden.greeting).

tools.doc: Gives a region its ambience loop: creates or edits the region's AmbienceDefinition and adds it to the audio set.

args.name: clipId
args.doc: Bank clip id of the loop.

args.name: assetPath
args.doc: Asset path of a new definition; defaults next to the set.

tools.doc: Adds or edits a music state of an audio set: its loop clip, crossfade and stinger; optionally makes it the start state.

args.name: clipId
args.doc: Bank clip id of the loop (empty = silence).

args.name: stingerId
args.doc: Bank clip id of a stinger played on entry.

args.name: start
args.doc: Make it the state a new world starts in.

args.name: assetPath
args.doc: Asset path of a new definition; defaults next to the set.

tools.doc: Finds legacy string and pseudo-category references (P1.3/P1.4 content) and, with apply, rewrites them as typed references; lists what it changed and what names nothing.
Import a retained artifact (verified by sha256) at 'path' and assign the imported asset to an [AuthorRef] field.

args.name: importer
args.doc: Importer settings (public importer properties by name, e.g. { "textureType": "Sprite" }).

tools.doc: Create a new authored object of an [Authorable] type: a definition asset (ScriptableObject types, at 'path') or a scene object carrying the component (MonoBehaviour types, under 'parent' or in the active scene). A fresh authoring id is minted.

args.name: type
args.doc: The [Authorable] type id (or CLR type name).

args.name: path
args.doc: Definitions: the .asset path or a folder under Assets/.

args.name: authoringId
args.doc: Restore a specific authoring id (journal undo/redo).

tools.doc: Delete a scene object (its GameObject and children) or an asset. Staging lists everything that references the target (query.impact).

args.name: componentOnly
args.doc: Scene objects: remove only the authored component, not the GameObject.

tools.doc: Appends a choice node with up to 8 options; targets name the node each option leads to (-1 = end).

args.name: targets
args.doc: Node each option leads to (-1 = end); missing entries end.

tools.doc: Appends a line node to a dialogue graph; with 'after' the new line continues that node.
Creates a dialogue graph and enrolls it in the active region world's narrative content set, with durable undo.
Studio tier Agent: requests a generated voice clip for a line through the media generation gateway (the paired Editor session supplies the provider).
Sets the condition of a branch node, or the availability condition of one option of a choice node.

args.name: option
args.doc: Option index of a choice node (-1 = the node itself, a branch).

tools.doc: Walks the graph over the initial facts plus overrides ('bell_rung=1; odd_paid=1') and prints every reachable path.
Sets the action set an action node runs (facts apply in the step, everything else through the outbox); null clears it.
Creates (or updates) a fact on a content set: name, initial value and whether it persists past a conversation.

args.name: persistent
args.doc: False = reset when a conversation ends.

args.name: authoringId
args.doc: Optional canonical GUID for a newly created fact; later candidate refs use this authoringId. Existing facts cannot be re-identified.

tools.doc: Replaces a condition set with one typed fact comparison. The fact AuthoringRef can name an earlier candidate output once the engine resolves dependency-ordered references; link this condition with dialogue.linkCondition.

args.name: fact
args.doc: Fact AuthoringRef, including the output of an earlier dialogue.setFact operation.

tools.doc: Revision-checked runtime action. No authored changes or inverse.
Duplicate a definition asset or a scene object. The copy is a new object with fresh authoring ids.

args.name: offset
args.doc: Scene objects: offset from the original's position.

args.name: path
args.doc: Assets: destination path (default: next to the original).

tools.doc: Sets one overridable field (scaleMilli, visible, alive, tint); an empty value clears it.

args.name: value
args.doc: Canonical value text; empty clears the override.

tools.doc: Revision-checked runtime action. No authored changes or inverse.
Copies a placed entity (definition, variant, overrides) with a fresh authoring id.
Places count copies of a definition evenly from start to end, facing along the line.
Places count copies of a definition on a ring around a centre, each facing it.
Places a definition in the active region scene at a position (m) and yaw (deg).

args.name: name
args.doc: Object name; defaults to the definition name.

tools.doc: Replaces a placed entity's definition; id, pose and overrides are kept and the variant is clamped.
Binds an imported Texture2D to a renderer material slot on every view of this definition. Omit texture to clear the binding. Changes content stamp, not recipe revision; rebuild views to apply.

args.name: texture
args.doc: Imported texture AuthoringRef; omit to clear.

args.name: renderer
args.doc: Renderer index in prefab depth-first order, including inactive children.

args.name: property
args.doc: Shader Texture2D property, for example _BaseMap or _MainTex.

tools.doc: Selects variant 0..n of the entity's definition.
Revision-checked runtime action. No authored changes or inverse.
Redo the latest undone change set (or 'changeSetId'). Retained artifacts are reused; nothing is regenerated.

args.name: changeSetId
args.doc: The change set to redo (default: the latest undone).

tools.doc: Undo the latest applied change set (or 'changeSetId') through its journaled inverse operations. Refused with Conflict when a touched object changed since, unless 'force'.

args.name: changeSetId
args.doc: The change set to undo (default: the latest applied).

args.name: force
args.doc: Undo even when touched objects changed since.

tools.doc: Adds (or updates, by name) a realtime point light under the region's 'Lights' object (lantern glow, shrine light). The region scene must be loaded.

Places (or updates, by name) a procedural scenery mesh in a region scene: kinds ground, house, inn, hut, well, tree, deadTree, reeds, rock, fence, jetty, punt, shrine, ruinWall, tower, bellFrame, water, causeway, lanternPost, stall, barrel. The region scene must be loaded.

args.name: position
args.doc: World position of the base centre.

args.name: size
args.doc: Size (x width, y height, z depth); zero = the kind's default.

args.name: materials
args.doc: Materials per submesh (missing entries reuse the last).

tools.doc: Configures Boot.unity's presentation (Boot.unity must be loaded): a global 'Post Processing' Volume with a profile asset (ACES tonemapping, bloom, colour adjustments, vignette), post-processing and FXAA on the main camera, soft shadows on the directional light.
Creates (or updates in place, keeping its GUID) a URP Lit material asset: base map and colour, smoothness, metallic, tiling, emission and an optional transparent surface.

Generates procedural Idle/Walk/Talk clips and an Animator Controller driven by the NPC animator binder's parameters (float Speed, int State: 0 idle, 1 patrol, 2 approach, 3 converse, 4 custom) and puts an Animator with it on the entity definition's view prefab.

args.name: folder
args.doc: Folder for the clips and the controller (Assets/...).

tools.doc: Writes the application's boot assets (Resources/Hollowmere/Application.asset) from the loaded Boot scene's GameBoot, so the player registers Hollowmere's definition at SubsystemRegistration (GameApplication.Register) before any scene loads.
Sets a region's atmosphere (fog, trilight ambient, sun, colour grading) on its 'Atmosphere' object; applied when the player enters the region. The region scene must be loaded.
Assigns materials to the view prefab of an entity definition: the renderer of the named child (default 'Body'), or every renderer when the child name is empty.

args.name: materials
args.doc: Materials per submesh (missing entries reuse the last).

args.name: childName
args.doc: Child holding the renderer (empty = every renderer).

tools.doc: Assigns materials to a named object of a region scene (first match, depth first), or hides it (deactivates it, keeping it in the scene). The region scene must be loaded.

args.name: materials
args.doc: Materials per submesh (missing entries reuse the last).

tools.doc: Describe an authored thing: its type, name, current authorable values, outgoing references, capabilities and incoming references.

args.name: includeReferrers
args.doc: Also list who references it (default true).

tools.doc: Explain why a rule, condition or interaction on the target did or did not fire, from the traces of a registered explain source. NotConfigured when no source can explain the target.

args.name: question
args.doc: What to explain (free text or a rule id).

tools.doc: Places a door or gate interactable (its definition's entity) at a location (m) and heading (deg).
Places an examinable (or point/switch) interactable at a location (m) and heading (deg).
Places a trigger volume (its definition's entity) at a location (m) and heading (deg).

args.name: location
args.doc: World position (bottom centre of the box).

tools.doc: Evaluates an interactable's condition over a state (logic.test terms; empty: the content's initial state) and names the first failed condition and the inputs it read.

args.name: state
args.doc: State terms: fact.<name>=v; item.<item>=n; quest.<quest>.status=v ... (empty: initial state).

tools.doc: Sets an interactable's condition (unlocks a lock when it holds, refuses a use when it fails): a condition set, or a fact compared with a value; neither = always allowed.

args.name: fact
args.doc: Fact condition (used when no condition set is given).

args.name: op
args.doc: Comparison of the fact condition (default: the fact is not 0).

args.name: value
args.doc: Value the fact is compared with.

tools.doc: Sets what a committed successful use runs: an action set, or a built-in action (inventory.pickup); neither = nothing.

args.name: actions
args.doc: Action set (wins over the built-in action).

tools.doc: Sets an interactable's initial state and its prompt per state ("state=text" entries).

args.name: initialState
args.doc: Initial state name (idle, closed, open, locked, used, broken, off, on).

tools.doc: Sets what using an item does: an action set run through the outbox; null makes the item unusable.

args.name: actions
args.doc: The actions using the item runs.

tools.doc: Sets how many of an item an inventory starts with (0 removes the line).
Places an item in a region as a world item the player can pick up once (action ref inventory.pickup).

args.name: entityId
args.doc: Placed scene entity that shows it (optional).

args.name: name
args.doc: Asset name; defaults to the item name.

tools.doc: Sets an item's base price; with a vendor, sets that vendor's buy price for the item instead (-1 = the item's price).

args.name: price
args.doc: Price (currency units); -1 only with a vendor.

args.name: vendor
args.doc: Vendor whose stock line price to set (empty: the item's base price).

tools.doc: Sets a vendor's stock line: count (or unlimited), the price the player pays and the price the vendor pays.

args.name: sellPrice
args.doc: Sell price (-1 = half the item's price, 0 = not bought).

tools.doc: Creates a rule: when the trigger happens and the conditions hold, the actions run (through the outbox, exactly once).

args.name: trigger
args.doc: The event that triggers the rule.

args.name: triggerSubject
args.doc: Trigger filter of the trigger's kind (fact, item, vendor, quest, graph, region, rule, world item); empty = any.

args.name: triggerValue
args.doc: Trigger value filter (e.g. the fact value); ignored when matchAnyValue.

args.name: triggerEntityId
args.doc: Entity authoring id filter for region/interaction triggers.

args.name: assetPath
args.doc: Asset path; defaults to <content set dir>/Rules/<name>.asset.

tools.doc: Explains a rule over the content's initial state: trigger, gates, every condition and its inputs, and the actions it would run.
Decides a rule over a test state and reports fire/skip, the first failed condition and the inputs read.

args.name: state
args.doc: State terms: fact.<name>=v; item.<item>=n; currency=n; quest.<quest>.status|stage|branch=v; visited.<graph>.<node>=0|1; now=ms; fired=n; cooldown=ms; counter=n.

tools.doc: Why does it not happen? For a gated subject (interactable, trigger, portal) or a rule: its condition over a state, the first failed condition, the inputs read, and the rules and action sets that would change what it reads.

args.name: subject
args.doc: The subject: an interactable, trigger or portal definition, or a rule.

args.name: state
args.doc: State terms as logic.test (empty: the content's initial state).

tools.doc: Propose a new mechanism (a UPM package with rules, runtime and tests). Produces a staged package through the staging lane; only admission can install it.

args.name: context
args.doc: Authored things the mechanism relates to.

args.name: package
args.doc: The staged package archive (worker candidates; read by the staging lane).

args.name: stageInputs
args.doc: Project paths copied into the stage slot (worker candidates; P2.4).

tools.doc: Move a scene object: world position, world rotation (quaternion), local scale, parent and sibling index (any subset). Gizmo drags and typed values produce the same operation.

args.name: parent
args.doc: New parent (keeps the world position unless 'position' is given).

tools.doc: Places an NPC (its definition's entity) at a location (m) and heading (deg) in the active region scene.

args.name: name
args.doc: Object name; defaults to the NPC's display name.

tools.doc: Revision-checked runtime action. No authored changes or inverse.
Selects the NPC's appearance: one of its entity definition's variants; null uses the definition itself.

args.name: variant
args.doc: A variant of the NPC's entity definition.

tools.doc: Assigns a standing behaviour (idle, patrol or custom) to an NPC; null makes it idle.
Assigns the dialogue graph a talk with the NPC starts; null removes it (the NPC has nothing to say).
Sets an NPC's patrol route (world-space points, looped); its behaviour becomes Patrol.

args.name: points
args.doc: Patrol points (at least one), world space.

tools.doc: Assigns a day schedule (phases by world time) to an NPC; null removes it.
Place an instance of a prefab at a location (a Location ref from PointAt) or a position. Authored components of the instance get fresh authoring ids.

args.name: position
args.doc: World position (when no location is given).

tools.doc: Sets the third-person orbit camera: distance, pivot height and pitch limits.
Moves the placed player entity to a location inside its region; the bake makes it the player's spawn pose.
Sets the player's walk/run speeds, jump height and stamina budget.
Compare a staged change set with the project now (per operation: preview before/after, and whether the target changed since staging), or two staged change sets with each other.

args.name: stagedId
args.doc: A change-set id staged by preview.stage.

args.name: other
args.doc: A second staged id to compare against.

tools.doc: Stage a change set without applying it: prechecks, tool dry runs and preview ghosts. Returns the staged id, the findings and each operation's preview.

args.name: candidate
args.doc: Validate in candidate mode (agent change sets).

args.name: toolCatalogRevision
args.doc: The catalog revision the candidate was planned against.

args.name: indexIsSlice
args.doc: The planner saw a bounded index slice.

tools.doc: Build a player through the build lane. NotConfigured until a build lane is registered.
Launch the last (or a named) build through the build lane. NotConfigured until a build lane is registered.
Refresh the AssetDatabase, forget cached types and tools, and rebuild the semantic index. Returns the new index and catalog revisions.
Save dirty assets and every open scene (the journal is independent of saving: an entry can be Applied and unsaved).
Everything deleting the target affects: its referrers, its contents and, transitively, their referrers.
List every authored thing that references the target, with the referencing field.
Adds an objective to a stage: talk (graph), collect (item), reach (region), interact (entity id) or fact (fact value).

args.name: target
args.doc: The dialogue graph (talk), item (collect), region (reach) or fact (fact).

args.name: branch
args.doc: 0 = always needed; n = part of branch n.

tools.doc: Appends a stage to a quest; returns its index.

args.name: next
args.doc: Next stage index when satisfied (-1 = the following one).

tools.doc: Reports a quest's status, stage, branch, objectives and prerequisites over a state (logic.test terms; empty: the initial state).

args.name: state
args.doc: State terms, e.g. quest.<quest>.status=1; quest.<quest>.stage=2; fact.<name>=v.

tools.doc: Adds a completion reward (an item count or a fact value), granted exactly once through the outbox.

args.name: target
args.doc: The item (item rewards) or the fact (fact rewards).

args.name: branch
args.doc: 0 = always; n = only on branch n.

tools.doc: Puts an objective on a branch (0 = always needed, n = an alternative way through its stage) and optionally names branch n.

args.name: branchName
args.doc: Name of branch n (journal, simulate); empty keeps the current name.

tools.doc: Sets the action sets run once when the quest completes (after its rewards) and when it fails; null clears one.
Sets the quests that must be completed before this one starts; a failed prerequisite closes this quest.
Plays a path through the quest rules: start; advance:n; fail; fact:<name>=v; talk:<graph>; collect:<item>=n; reach:<region>; interact:<entity id>.
Remove a component from a scene object (the target component, or the component of 'type' on the target object).

args.name: type
args.doc: Component type (when the target is the GameObject).

tools.doc: Replace a scene object with an instance of a prefab at the same parent, sibling index and placement. The replaced entity's authoring id moves to the new instance.
Read and verify one save slot (header, checksums, catalog compatibility) and preview the forward slot migration a restore would run.
Capture the running world, restore it into a new world and compare canonical slot hashes and logical steps; writes nothing and keeps the running world.
Set or clear authorable fields of an existing object. Give {field, value} or {fields: {name: value}}; each value has the type the object type declares for that field (catalog objectTypes).

args.name: value
args.doc: New value of 'field' (its type is the field's catalog type; null clears).

args.name: fields
args.doc: Several fields at once: { name: value }.

tools.doc: Adds a screen document to a flow: creates the UiDocumentDefinition (and a minimal UXML when the path does not exist).

args.name: screen
args.doc: The screen the document is shown on.

args.name: uxmlPath
args.doc: Project path of the UXML (created when missing).

args.name: assetPath
args.doc: Asset path of the new definition; defaults next to the UXML.

tools.doc: Binds an element property (text, value, visible, enabled, selected, items) of a UI document to a vm:, slot: or event: source.

args.name: element
args.doc: Element name in the document's UXML.

args.name: source
args.doc: vm:<model>.<Property> (hud.QuestStageTitle = first active quest stage title; hud.ObjectiveText = first unfinished objective) | slot:<owner>/<domain>.<member>@<target> | event:<name>.

args.name: property
args.doc: text | value | visible | enabled | selected | items.

args.name: format
args.doc: Format: a {0} pattern or percent:<max>; for items, command:<prefix>.

tools.doc: Renders one screen of a flow with a view-model state (model.Property=value;...) into a PNG; graphical Editor only.

args.name: state
args.doc: View-model state: model.Property=value pairs separated by ';' (arrays use '|').

args.name: outputPath
args.doc: Output PNG path; defaults under Library/GameCoreStudio/UiPreview.

tools.doc: Binds a button click (or a slider/toggle/dropdown change) to a UI command (open.<screen>, close, newgame, save.<n>, choose.<i>, volume.<channel>, ...).

args.name: element
args.doc: Element name in the document's UXML.

tools.doc: Sets a flow's theme (panel settings, theme style sheet and shared style sheets).
Places one end of the target portal in the open scene of one of the two regions it connects: a trigger volume whose forward axis points into the region.

args.name: yaw
args.doc: Heading of the arrival direction around +Y.

args.name: arrivalDistance
args.doc: Arrival distance in front of the portal.

args.name: region
args.doc: Region whose scene receives the end (empty: the portal's region whose scene is open; when both are, the one whose bounds hold the position).

tools.doc: Sets the spawn point travellers arrive at on each side of a portal and the condition set travel needs (e.g. 'the ferryman's favour OR the repaired punt': an Any-mode condition set).

args.name: condition
args.doc: Condition set travel needs (empty: always open).

args.name: spawnPointA
args.doc: Spawn point of region A (empty: the portal end's arrival pose).

args.name: spawnPointB
args.doc: Spawn point of region B (empty: the portal end's arrival pose).

tools.doc: Creates a portal connection between two regions of a world (a PortalDefinition asset beside the world).

args.name: assetPath
args.doc: Asset path of the new portal; defaults to <world dir>/Portals/<A>_<B>.asset.

args.name: spawnPointA
args.doc: Spawn point of region A travellers arrive at (empty: the portal end's arrival pose).

args.name: spawnPointB
args.doc: Spawn point of region B travellers arrive at (empty: the portal end's arrival pose).

args.name: condition
args.doc: Condition set travel needs (empty: always open).

tools.doc: Sets a region definition's bounds (world space, m); a zero size hands the bounds back to the scene's RegionBounds.

Sets a spawn point of the target region: recorded as a named spawn point of the region definition; when the region scene is open, the default one also creates or moves the scene's SpawnPoint child (a named one its 'SpawnPoint <name>' marker).

args.name: name
args.doc: Spawn point name (empty: default, the region's own spawn).

tools.doc: Revision-checked runtime action. No authored changes or inverse.
